procedural_issues_en: The itemized statement was received on August 24, after the computed August 21 deadline (3 days late). Under CT-47a-21-d2, this may expose the landlord to double damages; the supplied computed amount is $8,600. Consult a Connecticut tenant-rights group or lawyer about any claim and how the refund already received affects recovery.

The statement's refund equals the deposit less listed deductions and does not show the computed $21.01 accrued interest. Request the interest; CT-47a-21-d2 provides a separate remedy when failure to deliver interest is the only violation, but here the statement is also late.

The lease says the deposit is held in escrow, but the record provided does not show whether the required written notice naming the amount and financial institution was delivered. Check for that notice; CT-47a-21-h4.
procedural_issues_ko: 항목별 공제 명세서는 계산된 마감일인 8월 21일보다 3일 늦은 8월 24일에 도착했습니다. CT-47a-21-d2에 따라 임대인이 보증금의 두 배를 책임질 가능성이 있으며, 제공된 계산액은 8,600달러입니다. 청구 및 이미 받은 환불이 회수액에 미치는 영향은 코네티컷 세입자 권리 단체나 변호사와 확인하세요.
명세서의 환불액은 보증금에서 공제액만 뺀 금액으로, 계산된 이자 21.01달러가 포함되어 있지 않습니다. 이자를 요청하세요. 이자 미지급만이 위반인 경우 별도 구제 규정이 있지만, 이 건은 명세서도 늦었습니다.
계약서에는 보증금을 에스크로 계좌에 보관한다고 되어 있지만, 제공된 자료에는 보관액과 금융기관을 적은 필수 서면 통지를 받았는지 확인할 기록이 없습니다. 해당 통지를 확인하세요(CT-47a-21-h4).

items.note_en: Reject: the keys were returned July 31, 2027, so the lease p. 1 condition of an unreturned key is not met. See CT-47a-21-a14.

ruling.ruling_en: The only supported deduction is $350 for the new bedroom wall crack; the other claimed charges are rejected or remain unverified. The corrected deposit balance, including the stated $21.01 interest, is $3,971.01. The itemized statement arrived three days after the August 21 deadline despite the forwarding address being provided July 31; CT-47a-21-d2 may provide a remedy, but the stated $8,600 figure is not an automatic award. Check whether the required escrow notice was provided, and seek Connecticut tenant-rights or legal advice about the late statement and any claim.
ruling.ruling_ko: 입증된 공제는 새 침실 벽 균열 수리비 350달러뿐이며, 나머지 청구는 배척하거나 증빙 확인을 기다립니다. 제공된 이자 21.01달러를 포함한 정산 보증금 잔액은 3,971.01달러입니다. 주소를 7월 31일 제공했는데도 명세서는 8월 21일 기한보다 3일 늦게 도착했습니다. CT-47a-21-d2에 따른 구제 가능성이 있지만, 8,600달러가 자동으로 인정되는 것은 아닙니다. 에스크로 통지를 받았는지 확인하고, 지연 명세 및 청구 가능성은 코네티컷 세입자 권리 단체나 변호사와 상담하세요.
ruling.letter_en:
[Date]

To the Landlord,

I dispute the deductions in the itemized statement and request the corrected deposit balance of **$3,971.01**: the $4,300 deposit, less the sole supported deduction of $350, plus the stated $21.01 accrued interest.

The $480 Living room floor plank replacement charge is not supported because the same gouge appears at move-in and move-out (Exhibit E2, move-in record, date not provided; Exhibit E12, move-out evidence, July 31, 2027). The $165 Hallway wall patch and repaint near light switch charge is likewise for a condition present at both inspections (Exhibit E4, move-in record, date not provided; Exhibit E14, move-out evidence, July 31, 2027). Lease page 3 limits damage deductions to tenant-caused damage beyond ordinary wear. Connecticut General Statutes §§ 47a-21(a)(14) and 47a-11 address permissible deposit obligations and tenant-caused damage.

I accept only the $350 Bedroom wall crack repair and repaint charge for the new crack shown in Exhibit E20 (move-out evidence; date not provided), subject to the reasonable amount stated. I dispute the $150 Professional carpet cleaning charge because no supporting condition evidence was provided. Please provide the final Conservice bill or account statement supporting the $62.40 Final water/sewer bill (Conservice) charge. The $75 Rekeying - unreturned key charge is not supported because the keys were returned July 31, 2027; the lease condition on page 1 is not met.

The itemized statement was received August 24, 2027, after the August 21, 2027 deadline, although I provided my forwarding address July 31, 2027. Conn. Gen. Stat. § 47a-21(d)(2) sets the return and itemization requirement and may provide a remedy for a violation. Please also confirm whether you sent the written escrow notice required by § 47a-21(h)(4)(A), identifying the amount held and the financial institution. I reserve my rights regarding the late statement; I understand the stated $8,600 double-damages figure may require review and is not necessarily an automatic award.

Please remit the corrected balance of **$3,971.01** and reply within 10 days. If any portion of that amount has already been paid, please provide an itemized reconciliation showing the payment and remaining balance. I may consult a Connecticut tenant-rights group or lawyer regarding any statutory claim.

Sincerely,
[PERSON_1]
ruling.letter_ko_summary: 임대인에게 정산 보증금 잔액 3,971.01달러(보증금 4,300달러에서 승인 공제 350달러를 빼고 이자 21.01달러를 더한 금액)를 10일 이내 지급하고 회신하라고 요청합니다. 기존 흠집 공제와 청소비·미확인 수도요금·반환한 열쇠 재키잉 비용은 이의를 제기하고, 지연 명세 및 에스크로 통지 여부 확인을 요구합니다. 이중배상 가능성은 변호사나 세입자 권리 단체와 확인하도록 안내합니다.
